criteria.text: Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $2,600,000 (2 x ($5,300,000 - $4,000,000), subject to the $5,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $3,500,000 is wrong.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $620,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $189,380,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $188,760,000 is wrong.
Calculates the long-stop date as 13 October 2026 (90 days after signing on 15 July 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 27 November 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $2,600,000 and the Seller's $3,500,000.
Gives the long-stop period as 90 days and as the date 13 October 2026, with days remaining from 10 August 2026 (64 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
